newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 8.0 trln lire Btp,Cct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy seen issuing 8.0 trln lire Btp,Cct.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected on average to issue 8.0 trillion lire worth of fixed-rate bonds (Btp) and floating-rate certificates (Cct) at its end month medium and long term paper auctions, a Reuter poll of economists showed on Friday.
The auctions will be held on November 28 and 29.

"The amount of the issue will be limited because there is not much falling due," one analyst said. Due to mature at the start of December are 3.0 trillion lire of Cct, 30 billion lire of fixed-rate bonds with options attached (Cto), plus 6.5 trillion lire worth of coupons.
The Treasury will announce the amounts on offer next Monday.
On Thursday the Treasury said it will issue three, five and 10-year Btps and 7-year Ccts at the regular end-month auction.

The Treasury said said it would offer a ninth tranche of 1/10/96 Btps paying a 7.50 percent coupon, a ninth tranche of 15/09/96 Btps paying 7.75 percent coupon, a fifth tranche of 1/11/96 Btps paying a 7.75 percent coupon, and a third tranche of 1/09/96 Ccts paying an initial 3.80 pct coupon.
